text: Will Vincent here with a look at the
Suzuka International Racing Course set
in the heartland of Japan about 400 km
away from the nation's capital Tokyo.
Now Suzuka is set in the Mijana province
of Japan and it's a track of just under
6 km in length, 17 corners, lap record
held by Kim Reiken and set in 2005 with
a time of 1 minute 31.540.
This track is all about speed,
precision, and also having every part of
the car setup working together in
absolute harmony. You see, as we look
down the start finish straight, actually
a downhill gradient, which is going to
make starts and also getting our pit

not too much. But each of these parts
you've got to get absolutely perfect.
And they work together bringing you into

You can gain yourself about half a
